# Incremental Compilation

This feature allows for the compilation of changes introduced by merged pull requests and direct commits without recompiling the entire repository. It ensures that only relevant updates are processed and summaries generated.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.reconcile`
